pricing.tests_included_entry: No bundled default entry tier — fully a la carte from 80 individual tests and 21 panels
pricing.additional_test_cost: Each additional test adds only its own list price to an existing order — the $18/$10 order fees are charged once per order regardless of test count
pricing.state_restrictions: Available in 48 of 50 states. New York and New Jersey require a personal physician order (not yet available there); Rhode Island also excluded. Some individual tests also restricted for patients under 18.
pricing.ny_nj_surcharge: no - NY/NJ/RI are not surcharged, they are simply unavailable/blocked at checkout

tiers.tests_included: customer-selected

eligibility_reason: The task's original target (justlabs.com) is a dead/parked domain unrelated to any operating business. The actual live entity at justlabs.health is a straightforward self-pay OYO Quest lab marketplace with strong biomarker coverage relevant to peptide researchers, but it is a pure diagnostics/test-ordering service with no peptide/hormone therapeutic angle, no clinician interpretation, and no distinguishing longevity-platform features (no biological age score, no AI health coaching, no trend tracking) that would justify inclusion over the comparison set's target profile of purpose-built longevity/blood-testing platforms.
audience_overlap_notes: Strong biomarker relevance (has nearly every peptide-critical marker, including IGF-1, hs-CRP, ApoB, Lp(a), homocysteine — rare combination at this price point) and genuinely useful for cost-conscious peptide researchers wanting a la carte labs without a subscription. Worth flagging to the site owner as a possible 'cheapest way to get labs done' callout even though it's excluded from the main comparison table.
what_was_public: Entire test/panel catalog with exact pricing (80 tests, 21 panels) via public /api/tests and /api/catalog JSON endpoints, llms.txt with full business/pricing/FAQ summary, state availability and restrictions, FSA/HSA policy, About/schema.org org data, robots.txt confirming only checkout/dashboard/admin routes are gated, MCP server and OpenAPI spec for programmatic access
